proposal: The Mandate recommends unequivocal opposition to the previous Administration's proposed comprehensive financial account information reporting regime for business and personal accounts with more than $600, under which banks would file revised Forms 1099-K. It also says Congress and the Treasury Department should undertake a serious review of the information reporting regime and reduce the burden on the public, especially small businesses.

status_summary: No action reviving the comprehensive account reporting proposal was found. Public Law 119-21, approved 2025-07-04, lists Section 70432, repealing the 2021 revision to the de minimis rules for third party network transactions, and Section 70433, raising the payee information reporting threshold. The IRS stated on 2025-10-23 that the law retroactively reinstated the earlier Form 1099-K threshold of more than $20,000 and more than 200 transactions, and a trade publication reports the Form 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC threshold rises from $600 to $2,000 for 2026. These reduce specific reporting burdens; no broader review of the information reporting regime was found.

timeline.event: Public Law 119-21 was approved; its table of contents lists Section 70432 on third party network transaction reporting and Section 70433 raising the payee information reporting threshold.
The IRS issued FAQs (IR-2025-107) stating the law retroactively reinstated the Form 1099-K threshold of more than $20,000 and more than 200 transactions.

title: Oppose comprehensive $600 bank account reporting and cut information reporting burdens
uncertainties: The Form 1099-K threshold that the law restored was set by a 2021 statute and is distinct from the account reporting proposal the Mandate opposes; the Mandate mentions Form 1099-K only as part of that proposal, so the threshold changes are treated as partial progress on the burden-reduction item. Section text was not read because the GovInfo HTML is truncated; contents come from the table of contents, the IRS FAQ and a trade publication. Whether any later budget request revived the account reporting proposal was not searched.
